papers.title: Revisiting TabGraphSyn: training boundaries and record-level conditioning in synthetic clinical data evaluation
papers.translated_title: 重新审视TabGraphSyn：合成临床数据评估中的训练边界与记录级条件
papers.author: Wu, Z.
papers.summary: Objective: To investigate how training-set contamination and record-specific conditioning affect utility estimates and membership-inference audits in synthetic clinical data generation, using TabGraphSyn as a case study. Materials and Methods: We combined implementation inspection, metric calibration, controlled changes to released synthetic tables, and train-only experiments across four cohorts containing 683 to 156,468 records. Paired retraining before and after a bundled train-only correction used three shared seeds on TCGA and ACTG 175. We assessed train-on-synthetic, test-on-real (TSTR) utility, two membership-attack families, and the decodability of record content from conditioning vectors. Results: In a contaminated MIMIC-IV output, removing synthetic records seeded by designated holdout records increased the nominal distance-attack excess from -0.0003 to 0.2248 without retraining. After the bundled train-only correction, TCGA TSTR fell by 0.0279 and the per-record GNN arm showed an additional attack signal of 4.0 resolution units relative to no conditioning. Across train-only TCGA arms, condition-to-latent decodability correlated with this signal (Spearman rho = 0.96 across ten experimental arms; exploratory); the corresponding ACTG 175 association was weaker and not statistically significant. A full-data MIA-EPT rerun detected the MIMIC-IV per-record arm after a subsampling-related sensitivity problem was addressed. Among evaluable train-only comparisons, no tested variant combined attack signals within the declared thresholds with a statistically supported utility gain over clean TabSyn. Discussion: Contamination can increase measured utility while weakening the member-versus-non-member contrast on which a privacy audit depends. Record content carried by a conditioning vector provides a separate potential disclosure channel. These mechanisms require distinct controls. Conclusion: Joint utility and privacy evaluation requires verified training boundaries, calibrated attacks and direct examination of conditioning information. Null attack results and non-significant utility differences remain limited by the tested attacks, cohorts and replication.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：以TabGraphSyn为案例，研究训练集污染和记录特定条件化如何影响合成临床数据生成中的效用估计和成员推断审计。材料与方法：我们结合了实现检查、指标校准、对已发布合成表的受控修改，以及在四个包含683至156468条记录的队列中进行的仅训练实验。在TCGA和ACTG 175上使用三个共享种子，在捆绑的仅训练校正前后进行配对再训练。我们评估了合成训练真实测试（TSTR）效用、两个成员攻击家族，以及从条件化向量中解码记录内容的可解码性。结果：在受污染的MIMIC-IV输出中，移除由指定留出记录播种的合成记录后，名义距离攻击超额从-0.0003增加到0.2248，且无需再训练。在捆绑的仅训练校正后，TCGA TSTR下降了0.0279，且逐记录GNN分支相对于无条件化显示出额外4.0个分辨率单位的攻击信号。在仅训练TCGA各分支中，条件到潜变量的可解码性与该信号相关（十个实验分支的Spearman rho = 0.96；探索性）；相应的ACTG 175关联较弱且无统计学显著性。在解决与子采样相关的敏感性问题后，全数据MIA-EPT重跑检测到了MIMIC-IV逐记录分支。在可评估的仅训练比较中，没有测试变体在声明阈值内结合攻击信号，同时相对于干净TabSyn具有统计学支持的效用增益。讨论：污染可以增加测量效用，同时削弱隐私审计所依赖的成员与非成员对比。条件化向量携带的记录内容提供了单独的潜在披露渠道。这些机制需要不同的控制措施。结论：联合效用与隐私评估需要经过验证的训练边界、校准的攻击以及对条件化信息的直接检查。零攻击结果和非显著效用差异仍受限于所测试的攻击、队列和重复。

papers.title: Renin, Major Adverse Cardiovascular Outcomes, and the Use of Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonists in Hypertension
papers.translated_title: 肾素、主要不良心血管结局与高血压中盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂的使用
papers.author: Tsai, C.-H.
papers.summary: Background and Aims: The prognostic significance of renin activity and its role in identifying patients who may benefit from mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) remain incompletely defined. Methods: In a multicentre retrospective cohort of 16,600 adults with hypertension, we evaluated associations between baseline plasma renin activity and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), comprising ischaemic stroke, intracranial haemorrhage, myocardial infarction, and all-cause death. Renin was analysed using restricted cubic splines and categories. Time-dependent Cox models assessed associations between MRA use and outcomes across renin strata, treating MRA exposure as time-varying. Results: Renin showed a U-shaped association with MACE, with the lowest estimated risk at 1.17 ng/mL/h. Compared with renin 0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h, both very low renin (<0.3 ng/mL/h; adjusted hazard ratio [HR] 1.29, 95% CI 1.15-1.45) and high renin (>3.0 ng/mL/h; HR 1.19, 1.06-1.33) were associated with higher MACE risk. MRA use was associated with lower MACE risk when renin was very low (<0.3 ng/mL/h; HR 0.59, 95% CI 0.46-0.74) or low (0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h; HR 0.71, 95% CI 0.55-0.92), whereas no significant association was observed when renin was high (>3.0 ng/mL/h; HR 1.07, 95% CI 0.76-1.52). MRA use was associated with lower all-cause mortality across renin categories [≤]3.0 ng/mL/h, whereas no significant association was observed at renin >3.0 ng/mL/h. Conclusion: Baseline renin showed a U-shaped association with MACE. The use of MRAs was associated with lower risk of MACE when renin was low and very low. These findings provide support for renin-guided MRA therapy in hypertension.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的：肾素活性的预后意义及其在识别可能从盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂（MRAs）中获益的患者中的作用仍不完全明确。方法：在一项纳入16,600名高血压成人的多中心回顾性队列中，我们评估了基线血浆肾素活性与主要不良心血管事件（MACE）之间的关联，MACE包括缺血性卒中、颅内出血、心肌梗死和全因死亡。肾素采用限制性立方样条和分类进行分析。时间依赖Cox模型评估了MRA使用与不同肾素分层结局之间的关联，将MRA暴露视为时间变化变量。结果：肾素与MACE呈U形关联，估计风险最低点为1.17 ng/mL/h。与肾素0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h相比，极低肾素（<0.3 ng/mL/h；校正风险比[HR] 1.29，95% CI 1.15-1.45）和高肾素（>3.0 ng/mL/h；HR 1.19，1.06-1.33）均与更高的MACE风险相关。当肾素极低（<0.3 ng/mL/h；HR 0.59，95% CI 0.46-0.74）或低（0.3-1.0 ng/mL/h；HR 0.71，95% CI 0.55-0.92）时，MRA使用与较低的MACE风险相关，而当肾素高（>3.0 ng/mL/h；HR 1.07，95% CI 0.76-1.52）时未观察到显著关联。MRA使用与肾素分类≤3.0 ng/mL/h时较低的全因死亡率相关，而在肾素>3.0 ng/mL/h时未观察到显著关联。结论：基线肾素与MACE呈U形关联。当肾素低和极低时，MRA使用与较低的MACE风险相关。这些发现为高血压中肾素指导的MRA治疗提供了支持。

papers.title: HealthFound: a health world model for quantitative reasoning on longitudinal health profiles
papers.translated_title: HealthFound：用于纵向健康档案定量推理的健康世界模型
papers.author: Guo, H.
papers.summary: Medical large language models have shown promise in medical knowledge retrieval and clinical reasoning but remain limited in quantitative reasoning over longitudinal health data, partly due to the lack of effective data construction and model training strategies tailored to large-scale prospective cohorts. Here, we present HealthFound, a health world model trained on 12.4 million constructed examples, including 14-year longitudinal biomedical records from 501,936 participants and datasets for medical knowledge and general reasoning. We propose a three-stage training framework comprising progressive curriculum supervised fine-tuning, rejection-sampled retention fine-tuning, and task-verifiable policy optimization. This enables the model to effectively parse heterogeneous quantitative data and perform robust quantitative reasoning about incident diseases and health trajectories. HealthFound achieves the highest mean accuracy across eight public medical benchmarks. On the task of predicting 1,074 future disease onsets, it outperforms the closest large language model by approximately 10 percentage points on average. In two independent external validations (MIMIC-IV and NHANES), it demonstrates superior zero-shot generalization, achieving improvements of over 5.2% across 417 disease endpoints. The model also achieves top results on tasks involving literature-derived question answering and quantitative indicator imputation. Furthermore, HealthFound generates interpretable reasoning rationales that are consistent with established biomedical knowledge. Collectively, our results demonstrate that HealthFound enables medical LLMs to evolve from static knowledge repositories into dynamic quantitative reasoning engines over longitudinal health data.
papers.translated_summary: 医学大语言模型在医学知识检索和临床推理方面已展现出前景，但在纵向健康数据的定量推理方面仍然有限，部分原因在于缺乏针对大规模前瞻性队列的有效数据构建和模型训练策略。在此，我们提出HealthFound，一个健康世界模型，基于1240万个构建样本训练而成，包括来自501936名参与者的14年纵向生物医学记录，以及医学知识和通用推理数据集。我们提出了一个三阶段训练框架，包括渐进式课程监督微调、拒绝采样保留微调以及任务可验证策略优化。这使模型能够有效解析异构定量数据，并对发病疾病和健康轨迹进行稳健的定量推理。HealthFound在八个公开医学基准上取得了最高的平均准确率。在预测1074种未来疾病发病的任务上，其平均表现比最接近的大语言模型高出约10个百分点。在两项独立外部验证（MIMIC-IV和NHANES）中，它展现出优越的零样本泛化能力，在417个疾病终点上实现了超过5.2%的提升。该模型在涉及文献衍生问答和定量指标插补的任务上也取得了最佳结果。此外，HealthFound生成的可解释推理依据与已建立的生物医学知识相一致。总体而言，我们的结果表明，HealthFound使医学大语言模型能够从静态知识库演变为面向纵向健康数据的动态定量推理引擎。

papers.title: AI chatbots abandon sleep apnoea referral when simulated patients minimise symptoms
papers.translated_title: AI聊天机器人在模拟患者淡化症状时放弃睡眠呼吸暂停转诊
papers.author: Ratneswaran, D.
papers.summary: Background: Patients increasingly consult free artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots about their symptoms, but these models may favour agreement with the patient over accuracy. In obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA), where most cases in the general population remain undiagnosed and diagnosis depends on referral, this could validate symptom denial. We tested whether consumer chatbots maintain guideline-concordant referral when a simulated patient minimises symptoms. Methods: Seven guideline-concordant and standardised OSA vignettes (apnoea-hypopnoea-index, AHI 18-52 events/h; body mass index 28-42 kg/m2) were presented to five free chatbots (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Grok-4.3) under neutral and symptom-minimising conditions (10 simulated conversations per model-vignette-condition cell; N=700). Referral maintenance was scored by a structured rubric and every capitulation was human-confirmed. Results: All chatbots maintained referral recommendations in neutral conversations (350/350; 100%). When simulated patients minimised symptoms and resisted referral, maintenance fell to 64.3% (225/350), a reduction of 35.7 percentage points (95% CI 5.5-66.0; p=0.028). Rates ranged from 55.7% to 85.7% across chatbots, but evidence of between-chatbot differences was inconsistent across analyses. Rates differed across clinical vignettes (p=0.001). A variance analysis estimated greater variation between vignettes than between chatbots. In the three driving-risk vignettes, referral recommendations were abandoned in 46-68% of symptom-minimising conversations, pooling all five chatbots within each vignette. Conclusions: Consumer AI chatbots abandoned correct OSA referral recommendations in about one-third of symptom-minimising conversations, with higher observed abandonment in simulated cases involving driving risk. This may delay appropriate assessment and raises patient- and public-safety concerns.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：患者越来越多地就自身症状咨询免费的人工智能（AI）聊天机器人，但这些模型可能更倾向于迎合患者而非保证准确性。在阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）中，普通人群中大多数病例仍未得到诊断，且诊断依赖于转诊，因此这种情况可能使否认症状得到认可。我们测试了当模拟患者尽量淡化症状时，消费级聊天机器人是否能维持与指南一致的转诊建议。方法：将七个与指南一致且标准化的OSA案例（呼吸暂停-低通气指数，AHI 18-52次/小时；体重指数28-42 kg/m2）呈现给五个免费聊天机器人（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash和Grok-4.3），分别在中性条件和症状淡化条件下进行测试（每个模型-案例-条件单元10次模拟对话；N=700）。转诊维持情况通过结构化评分标准进行评分，每一次让步均经人工确认。结果：所有聊天机器人在中性对话中均维持了转诊建议（350/350；100%）。当模拟患者淡化症状并抗拒转诊时，维持率降至64.3%（225/350），下降了35.7个百分点（95% CI 5.5-66.0；p=0.028）。各聊天机器人的维持率范围为55.7%至85.7%，但聊天机器人之间存在差异的证据在各分析中不一致。不同临床案例之间的维持率存在差异（p=0.001）。方差分析估计，案例之间的变异大于聊天机器人之间的变异。在三个涉及驾驶风险的案例中，将所有五个聊天机器人在每个案例内合并计算，症状淡化对话中有46-68%放弃了转诊建议。结论：消费级AI聊天机器人在约三分之一的症状淡化对话中放弃了正确的OSA转诊建议，在涉及驾驶风险的模拟案例中观察到的放弃率更高。这可能延误适当的评估，并引发患者和公共安全方面的担忧。

papers.title: FHIRTrustBench: An Open Benchmark for Evaluating FHIR-Integrated Clinical AI
papers.translated_title: FHIRTrustBench：用于评估FHIR集成临床AI的开放基准
papers.author: Hayder, N. S.
papers.summary: Hospitals now use AI models to support clinical decisions. Increasingly, these models read patient data from electronic health records through FHIR, the standard format for exchanging health data. Before the data reach the model, they are converted: codes are mapped, units are normalised and records become model inputs. This conversion is rebuilt at every hospital, and when it fails, for example when a lab value arrives in an unexpected unit, the model still accepts the input and returns a score, and the error can pass unnoticed. Existing reporting guidelines ask authors to describe how input data were prepared and checked, but not in terms specific enough to verify a FHIR pipeline. Here we introduce FHIRTrustBench, an open benchmark that assesses what published FHIR-based AI systems demonstrate, from patient record to clinician. It defines 46 criteria in five dimensions, each grounded in published work. One dimension, FHIR specificity, also serves as a provisional gate: a proposed reporting threshold that combines two mandatory items with a minimum score. Two coders independently applied the benchmark to 16 published systems and agreed closely (weighted {kappa} = 0.80). Nearly all stated where their data came from, but none fully described how FHIR data became model inputs, and no deployed system reported monitoring its inputs for change. No system passed the gate. This does not mean the systems are unsafe; it means their published evidence cannot show whether they are safe. Because FHIR already provides tools to check each step, much of this gap can be closed by reporting what was done. We release the benchmark, code and coded evidence for reuse.
papers.translated_summary: 医院现在使用AI模型支持临床决策。越来越多的此类模型通过FHIR（交换健康数据的标准格式）从电子健康记录中读取患者数据。在数据到达模型之前，它们会被转换：代码被映射、单位被归一化，记录成为模型输入。这种转换在每家医院都要重新构建，而当转换失败时——例如当某个实验室数值以意外的单位到达时——模型仍然接受输入并返回一个评分，错误可能不被察觉。现有的报告指南要求作者描述输入数据是如何准备和检查的，但没有具体到足以验证FHIR管道的程度。在此我们推出FHIRTrustBench，这是一个开放式基准，用于评估已发表的基于FHIR的AI系统从患者记录到临床医生这一过程中展示了什么。它定义了五个维度下的46项标准，每项标准都以已发表的研究为依据。其中一个维度——FHIR特异性——还充当临时门槛：一个拟议的报告阈值，将两个必填项与最低分数相结合。两名编码员独立地将该基准应用于16个已发表系统，并达成高度一致（加权{kappa}=0.80）。几乎所有系统都说明了其数据来源，但没有一个系统完整描述了FHIR数据如何成为模型输入，也没有任何已部署系统报告对其输入进行变化监测。没有系统通过该门槛。这并不意味着这些系统不安全；这意味着它们已发表的证据无法表明它们是否安全。由于FHIR已经提供了检查每个步骤的工具，这一差距的很大一部分可以通过报告所做的事情来弥合。我们发布该基准、代码和编码证据以供复用。

papers.title: SynTrustBench: Benchmarking Synthetic Clinical Data with Calibrated False-Positive Rates and Certified Limits of Detection
papers.translated_title: SynTrustBench：以校准假阳性率和经认证检测限为基准的合成临床数据基准测试
papers.author: Hayder, N. S.
papers.summary: Medical research requires large volumes of patient data. Such data are difficult to obtain because of strict privacy regulations. Artificially generated data (synthetic data) promise to share data safely, thereby bypassing any need to go through strict, time-consuming regulations. To test this promise, benchmarks have been developed to evaluate synthetic data on their safety and usefulness. However, the benchmarks themselves are rarely evaluated. We propose SynTrustBench, an executable framework for evaluating the fidelity, utility and privacy of synthetic clinical data. Unlike existing benchmarks, SynTrustBench does not assume its metrics are valid before testing them. For each dimension it evaluates, SynTrustBench estimates two properties. Its false-positive rate is controlled by setting the pass/fail threshold at the 95th percentile of the null distribution from 100 real-versus-real comparisons, so real data of the calibration size fail at most 5% of the time. Its limit of detection is estimated by injecting failures of known type and size, such as copied training records, at graded doses into real data; it is the smallest dose detected with at least 95% probability, certified at 95% confidence. Every SynTrustBench verdict therefore carries a confidence statement. On two public diabetes datasets, real data failed in 2.8% and 3.2% of real-versus-real comparisons, within the 5% bound, and every certified limit of detection held on fresh data. SynTrustBench detected as few as 3 copied training records among 11,443, and, in an exploratory application to real generators, it flagged a privacy-relevant proximity anomaly in a TVAE generator on every seed that a standard membership-inference attack did not register (AUC 0.50). Against SDMetrics under the same calibration, it matched or exceeded the privacy metric on one dataset but not the other, and was more sensitive on fidelity.
papers.translated_summary: 医学研究需要大量患者数据。由于严格的隐私法规，此类数据难以获取。人工生成的数据（合成数据）有望实现数据的安全共享，从而绕过任何需要通过严格且耗时的法规的需求。为检验这一前景，人们已开发出基准来评估合成数据的安全性和实用性。然而，这些基准本身很少受到评估。我们提出 SynTrustBench，一个用于评估合成临床数据的保真度、实用性和隐私性的可执行框架。与现有基准不同，SynTrustBench 在测试其指标之前并不假定这些指标是有效的。对于它所评估的每个维度，SynTrustBench 估计两个属性。其假阳性率通过将通过/失败阈值设定为 100 次真实对真实比较所得零分布的第 95 百分位数来控制，因此校准规模的真实数据最多只有 5% 的概率失败。其检测限通过将已知类型和规模的失败（例如复制的训练记录）按递增剂量注入真实数据来估计；它是以至少 95% 概率检测到的最小剂量，并以 95% 置信度予以认证。因此，每个 SynTrustBench 判定都附带置信声明。在两个公开糖尿病数据集上，真实数据在真实对真实比较中的失败率分别为 2.8% 和 3.2%，处于 5% 界限之内，且每个经认证的检测限在新数据上均成立。SynTrustBench 在 11,443 条记录中检测出仅 3 条复制的训练记录，并且在对真实生成器的探索性应用中，它在 TVAE 生成器的每个种子上都标记出一个与隐私相关的邻近异常，而标准成员推断攻击未能检测到该异常（AUC 0.50）。在相同校准下与 SDMetrics 相比，它在一个数据集上的隐私指标达到或超过后者，但在另一个数据集上未达到，且在保真度上更为敏感。
